products.name: Finasteride
products.medical_product_information:
Each tablet contains: finasteride 1mg


Finasteride  increases hair growth on the scalp and prevents further hair loss in men. Men with mild to moderate, but not complete hair loss, can benefit from using finasteride.

Do not take finasteride  if:
  • you are a woman (because this medicine is for men). It has been shown in clinical trials that finasteride does not work in women with hair loss.
  • you are allergic (hypersensitive) to finasteride or any of the other ingredients
  • you are already taking finasteride or dutasteride used for a prostate problem called benign prostatic hyperplasia (BPH).
  • you are diagnosed with depression or develop depression whilst on treatment. 

Taking this medicine
  • The usual dose is one tablet each day.
  • Take this medicine by mouth.
  • Finasteride  will not work faster or better if you take it more than once a day.

Side effects may include:
  • you may be unable to have an erection (impotence)
  • you may have less desire to have sex
  • you may have problems with ejaculation, for example a decrease in the amount of semen released during sex. This decrease in the amount of semen does not appear to affect normal sexual function.
  • you may develop mental health problems and depression. 

These side effects above may disappear after a while if you continue taking finasteride. If these symptoms persist, they usually resolve after stopping finasteride. If you develop depression, please stop immediately and speak to your doctor.

products.name: Telephone Consultation with a Doctor (does not include prescription medication): Available 2-3pm Friday
products.medical_product_information:
Detailed assessment for this condition, including a ten minute telephone consultation with a doctor. Appointments are available between 2pm and 3pm on Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday. 

Includes:

  • Advice from the doctor about any specific queries you may have

  • Recommendations for further investigation and examination where needed

  • Recommendations for possible medical treatments if appropriate

Appointments do not include any treatment costs. Where appropriate our doctors may advise that you may need further investigations or a face to face assessment by your GP.

Please note that this is not an emergency or urgent service, and your assessment will not be reviewed by a doctor until your telephone consultation. If you are unwell or worried about any of your symptoms before this time please contact your GP or local urgent care services.

Unfortunately we are not able to consult through a third person or interpreter due to confidentiality reasons. The telephone consultation can only be with the patient alone.
